nodes.title: 首帧 + 模板提示词编排

metadata.prompt:
请基于下方 LuxReal 原始镜头模板与首帧参考图，编排可供映雪 image_to_video 使用的镜头运动提示词。
原始模板内容：
{
'type': 'B-roll','function_tag': 'Immersive Product Scenario',
'Demand': Generate a wide or medium-long shot. [Subject & Composition Rules]:1. DO NOT CROP THE HUMAN BODY AWKWARDLY. The composition must feature a full-body or 3/4 body shot of a model.2. The model is the primary carrier of the lifestyle vibe, interacting with the [Product] naturally.3. Avoid close-ups on hands. We need to see the model's posture, head, and torso to establish the scale of the furniture/item.[Interaction Logic]:- For Seating (Chairs, Sofas, Toilets): The model must be SITTING ON or RELAXING IN the product completely, or walking past it naturally. Do not just touch it with a hand.- For Surface Furniture (Desks, Tables): The model sits BEHIND or stands NEXT TO it, engaging in a task (reading, working, drinking), incorporating the furniture into their activity.- For Small Appliances (Lamps, Accessories): Show the model holding or using it within a wider scene (e.g., sitting on a rug adjusting a lamp), not just a hand zoom-in.[Constraint]: No disembodied limbs. No floating hands. The camera distance must be far enough to see both the person and the product clearly in a room context.'
}，
原始模板文本和首帧参考图已通过画布上游连线接入，不要把原演示视频当作生成输入。
保持主体、构图、材质和动作连续；不要把原演示视频当作生成结果。
